line: I hire out crews. That is all I say to one I do not know. Earn my regard. Then I will say more. Heavy-Rope, on this dock, can tell you of the refusal.

prompt: Tell me about the dock crews.
line: For thirty years I bought out Owings, the debts that bind a person to labour. I freed those crews. Now I hire them out. They work the season as agreed.
